name: strategy_validate
label: strategy_validate
description: Validate an authored SVL/1 JSON file and return its actual semantic digest, operators and graph. This does not run a native engine or place orders.

source_path.description: Workspace path to the authored SVL JSON file

name: strategy_publish
label: strategy_publish
description: Publish a validated SVL source as an immutable strategy.source artifact. Preserve this exact reference for target translation and future trade evidence.

operation_id.description: Unique idempotency key for this exact publication

artifact_id.description: Existing artifact ID when publishing a new revision

expected_revision.description: Exact current revision when updating an existing artifact

name: strategy_graph
label: strategy_graph
description: Read a fixed SVL source artifact and derive its graph from the same validated AST. No layout or explanation is treated as execution evidence.

name: strategy_replay
label: strategy_replay
description: Evaluate fixed ordered input events against a saved SVL source. Produces state, intents and actual evaluator traces; it is not a broker simulator, native backtest or translation-equivalence receipt.

fixture_path.description: Workspace JSON with runId, parameters, initialState and ordered events

output_path.description: Optional workspace path for the complete evaluation result

operation_id.description: If provided, preserve this replay as a generic resource artifact

name: strategy_pipeline
label: strategy_pipeline
description: Check and evaluate a frozen signal → target portfolio → risk → execution fixture. Reads exact artifact references and preserves optional evidence. No model, broker, matching engine or native strategy is executed.

fixture_path.description: Workspace JSON conforming to the plugin pipeline.md fixture contract

output_path.description: Optional workspace path for the complete evaluation result

operation_id.description: If provided, preserve the fixture and result as a resource artifact

name: strategy_workflow
label: strategy_workflow
description: Run frozen dynamic-universe selection, actual equal/confidence/inverse-volatility portfolio sizing, hard portfolio risk and a replayable execution ledger. Returns quantities, cash, risk evidence, linked order definitions and proposed commands; never sends orders or invokes a model.

fixture_path.description: Workspace JSON conforming to methods.md workflow schema 1.1

output_path.description: Optional workspace path for the complete workflow and execution checkpoint

operation_id.description: If provided, preserve the frozen input and full result as a resource artifact

name: strategy_decision
label: strategy_decision
description: Run an isolated versioned Agent signal or risk decision with the configured model and frozen artifact inputs. Submit is asynchronous; status waits optionally, cancel/invalidate retire requests, timeline exports actual saved outputs without new model calls. Never places orders.

request_path.description: Workspace JSON decision request conforming to references/agent-inputs.md

job_id.description: Job ID returned by submit; selects its portfolio run for invalidate/timeline

wait.description: Wait for this one job to finish; cancellation of the tool wait does not cancel the job

as_of_ms.description: UTC time for timeline replay or cancel/invalidate; required for historical invalidation

output_path.description: Workspace JSON path for the saved immutable decision timeline

operation_id.description: Idempotency key to publish a saved timeline as an evidence resource

name: strategy_functions
label: strategy_functions
description: Write the versioned declarative SVL quant function module (RSI, ATR, MACD, Bollinger, Donchian, z-score and realized volatility) to the workspace. Embed the whole frozen extension in an SVL 1.2 source; formulas expand into the same graph and replay.

output_path.description: Workspace JSON path for the complete frozen extension object
